name: pg_station
notes: Rim station: a maroon-brown steel capsule, 11.6 m by 11.6 m with its stairs and 24.9 m to the crane top, six floors of 3 m with a spiral stair, a wet lab at the waterline, balconies and zigzag stairs outside and a jib crane on the roof. A door and landing at 4.5 m on the +Z side take the walkway.
